authority: Operator-authorized bounded research; not Gate A operator acceptance, product runtime or publication of third-party payloads.
decision: Admit or refuse the complete repeated-reference source to the current conditional comparison interface; if structurally feasible, qualify a bounded complete-image paired inference pilot and test reference-procedure coupling.
exposure: Primary papers, model and dataset metadata and inference source read; no raw annotations, images, weights or outputs opened before freeze.

source.dataset_terms: CC BY-NC-SA4.0; noncommercial research; raw private. Christina Bukas et al., MultiOrg, DOI10.34740/kaggle/ds/5097172. Models CC BY4.0.

phase_a.reject: Missing/extra files, duplicate JSON keys, nonfinite coordinates, malformed/non-axis-aligned/degenerate rectangles; no repairs or dropping. Parser schema qualified against actual payload before declaring validity.
phase_a.reference_semantics: t0 is initial mixed expert A/B procedure; t1_A and t1_B repeated expert procedures. All started from algorithmic pseudolabels; neither independent raters nor physical truth. t0 used for checkpoint selection.
phase_a.native_object_admission: Conservative source-qualified union: sum of all3 box counts <=128 per whole image. Source-qualified identities are retained even for coincident geometry; this is the direct guarded-union representation, not proof that every equivalent representation is impossible. Other native caps remain mandatory.
phase_a.selection: Sort structurally valid eligible images ascending SHA256(UTF8(reiyah.multiorg.pilot.v1 + newline + exact TIFF path)), break ties by exact path; freeze first min(4,n), first is feasibility pilot. Preserve all55 rows; selected subset not population representative.
phase_a.stop: If any acquisition missing, census incomplete; no replacement. If zero eligible images, refuse direct guarded-union admission and stop model/image acquisition.

phase_b.coordinates: Preserve source decoded floored coordinates including padded out-of-image boxes; no clipping; native incompatibility refuses admission. Qualify row/column inversion using asymmetric controls.
phase_b.nms: Independent float32 implementation; descending score with original-index tie break. Declare departure from unspecified upstream equal-score tie behavior; no bitwise parity claim.
phase_b.coverage: Every planned tile of every selected whole image. Missing/invalid/timeout never empty; no replacement by easier image. One paired image cannot establish cross-image coupling.
phase_b.resource_policy: Private RESOURCE_AMENDMENT_0.1.0; retain measured wall, bytes, runtime and all failures.

endpoint.loss: FP+FN for all analysis boxes, unit cost, exact maximum-cardinality one-to-one IoU>=1/2 matching, no score-priority matching. No AP or paper-score reproduction claim.
endpoint.global: G=[min_r sum_i d_ir,max_r sum_i d_ir]/n, r in t0,t1_A,t1_B
endpoint.imagewise: P=[sum_i min_r d_ir,sum_i max_r d_ir]/n; declared unobserved hybrid stress family, not probabilistic independence.
endpoint.decision: Positive lower endpoint supports B under the declared finite reference family; negative upper supports A; otherwise unresolved. Margin0.
endpoint.primary: For a complete selected pilot with >=2 images, determine whether a resolved G becomes unresolved P. G subset P required. If G unresolved mechanism endpoint inconclusive; if same resolved no observed fragility.
endpoint.baseline: Ordinary complete matching census plus min/sum arithmetic; no 3^n brute-force straw comparator. Independently authored checker required.

acceptance: All55 roster entries and all165 annotation files accounted for with exact bytes/digests
Separately authored checker agrees on geometry counts and selection
Native capacity failures explicit without cap changes
Before inference, runtime/coordinate/NMS controls pass and actual models pinned
Any reported paired endpoint requires complete frozen selected cohort and independent matching/arithmetic agreement
falsifier: Malformed source, admission refusal, runtime failure or unresolved/unchanged reference interval is retained, never tuned away. A successful pilot establishes source-specific engineering feasibility only.
